capture.zh: 在怀特星魔窟挑战米诺斯，打败后获得1个米诺斯精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 用飞行、机械、超能系克制：盖亚日月皆伤+返璞归真消耗，艾尔伊洛星体解离术，迪普利德魔力漩涡，闪光艾菲亚无限之光收尾。

engine_notes: skills: all four are named by 4399 2011-10-27 (常用技能; 狂暴裂袭 is a typo for 狂暴烈袭) and by a 4399 reader report of 2011-10-25 that lists their effects; they equal species 957's last four at or below Lv80.
reward: original reward was the species' 精元 (essence), hatched in the 分子转化器 into the base form (e.g. 兰斯特 精元 → 卡斯, 伊索里 → 伊索的精元); encoded as the base-form species at Lv1.
Immune to stat drops and innate atk+2: 4399 2011-10-25 天生强化2…弱化无效，控场无效; 4399 2011-10-27 有天生攻击强化…免疫所有异常和能力下降技能.
Immune to status (immune_status): 4399 2011-10-27 免疫所有异常和能力下降技能; 4399 2011-10-25 控场无效.
Sure-hit moves (always_hit) and unlimited PP: 4399 2011-10-27 自身所有技能必中，自身PP值无限. The modern client's trait list (idx 58 and 79) supports both.

Below half HP, once: all five stats +1 and its attacks' crit rate 4/16 (crit_rate_up +3 on the base 1/16): 4399 2011-10-27 血量低于1/2，自身全属性等级+1，所有攻击技能致命一击率达到1/4. 全属性 is the five stats, as 4399 2010-06-01 words 龙之意志 (5项属性得到提升).

Every player pet that enters starts at accuracy -2 (foe_stage_on_entry), the lead before the first command included: 4399 2011-10-27 所有出战精灵初始命中等级-2，我方对米诺斯的攻击，MISS率非常高. Switching out resets stages, so each entry applies it again.
